adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration reads the legacy site setting value, splits it into lines (records.each do |h|), and then constructs SQL via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (...) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. Because `h` is inserted unescaped inside single quotes, any stored value containing a `'` will at minimum break the migration, and could be used for SQL injection at migration time if an admin previously stored a malicious line in the old `embeddable_hosts` setting.
